summary:
Main
Iron ore combined price weakness with selective support today. DCE most-traded closed at 683.5 yuan/mt, down 0.07% from the previous close, and all eightQingdao spot products fell 1 yuan. The 61% port index rose 1 yuan while the 58% and 65% held steady.
